title: CDC WONDER
description: Documented public public health data (US CDC) for the Public Health Monitor capability area.
body:
CDC WONDER is a documented public health data from US CDC. The CDC's Wide-ranging Online Data for Epidemiologic Research: queryable mortality, natality, and disease datasets.

How it works: It works by integrating the SIR differential equations day by day, tracking the infection peak and the basic reproduction number.

Documented uses of this capability area include city digital twins, power-grid planning, water-network operations, epidemic modeling, and disaster early warning.
